scope: Sanitized staging tree, paused-state context, portable prerequisites and packaging tools. No services, backend builds, runtime tests, dependency installs or native queries were performed by this review.

resolvedFindings.finding: Archive directory members bypassed the required top-level folder prefix.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Directory and file names now enforce the expected archive root; duplicate members and global/member comments are rejected.

resolvedFindings.finding: Directory-form symlink metadata bypassed file-only mode validation.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Unix symlink and other special member modes are rejected before branching on directory entries.

resolvedFindings.finding: Startup accepted an edited run image identity without checking the bundled backend pin.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Start revalidates format/backend/unique owner, pinned image/reference, memory/internal port and bootstrap map against bundled manifests.

resolvedFindings.finding: A substituted configuration symlink could be mounted into a fresh runtime.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Start rejects configuration symlinks and requires the bundled configuration digest.

resolvedFindings.finding: Fresh-data map ignored special entries and unexpected directories.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Start now rejects every nonregular or nonflat entry via lstat before hashing or contacting Docker, then requires the exact pristine filename/hash map.

resolvedFindings.finding: The first archive candidate correctly emitted required ZIP64 header-offset metadata above the writer threshold, while the initial bundled verifier rejected every extra field.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The verifier now accepts only an exact ZIP64 tag1/length8 field whose value equals the actual header offset at or above the ZIP64 threshold. Timestamp, ownership, comment and other arbitrary metadata remain rejected. Final archive SHA and parity are a separate post-freeze gate.

qleverBootstrap.result: All allowlisted staged bytes matched the retained immutable bootstrap; no update snapshot or telemetry included.

copiedOracleInputs.result: All original expected SHA256 values match the staged oracle inputs.

confirmedInputs.workspace: Workspace manifests/lock, required packages, public dist snapshots and hidden documentation configuration are present.

portableToolAssessment.verifyBundle: Checks exact exported membership/digests and safe archive structure. Explicitly does not assert original Git-origin verification, runtime correctness or a digital signature.
portableToolAssessment.materializeVariant: Requires a new destination, validates object digests and safe relative member paths, and does not execute materialized source.
portableToolAssessment.offlineRegistry: Verifies captured package identity/bytes before loopback-only serving; no remote proxy or lifecycle execution is performed by the registry.
portableToolAssessment.prepareLocalRun: Default action prepares a new folder without starting a service. Explicit start refuses existing unique owner names, nonlocal Docker endpoints, platform/pin drift, occupied published ports, changed initial data and symlink paths; it runs as the current UID/GID and performs no ownership changes or resource replacement. Initial contents must now be flat regular files only; FIFOs, devices, sockets and unexpected directories are refused before Docker calls.

declaredLimitsThatRemain: Recipient native startup and dependency/lifecycle installation have not been executed or qualified.

Unique-owner readiness, resource admission and original-origin controller assumptions still require explicit portable adaptation; direct contract checks are not equivalent to qualified controller receipts.
Startup checks a starter disk reserve but does not reserve aggregate Docker/host/client memory or future ingestion/backup capacity; target capacity admission remains required.
Historical recovery fixtures refer to omitted retained database state and cannot run unchanged on the one-triple bootstrap.
The latest unchanged query-suite self-rule failure, untested adapter sub-budget edits, earlier failures and incomplete ten-goal/scale/comparison target remain explicit.
The export uses a separate packaging profile and does not claim the earlier development storage gate covered staging or ZIP overlap.

citationCoverageReview.scope: Alternate full-paper identity was checked from bundled first-page text; related material is not relabeled as an identical missing landing/listing page.

packagingOwnerReportedChecks.scope: Private packaging-tool fixtures, including FIFO and unexpected-directory rejection; reported by the packaging owner, not independently executed by this reviewer.
